stage1.impression: A dark, tidy home-cinema or showroom: two speakers in a fir-lined niche, a black void around them, a bright cool projection-like screen on the left and a glowing orb in the foreground. The fir boards are smooth, even and repeat like a texture, the carpet is a flat brown plane, the ceiling and walls fall to black, and the drivers and the plinths' clipped glowing edges show denoiser smear and CG-bright strips. None of the shell (concrete, beams, blackened steel) can be read, and there is no sign of life, so a magazine would see a generic hi-fi demo room, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The shell has to be legible: board-formed concrete with tie holes, a fir beam overhead and blackened steel each readable at 1:1 somewhere in the frame (top band lum_median above 12, currently 4.1)
The speakers must be the brightest thing in the frame that is not a lamp: speaker regions lum_median 45 or more (now 27 and 24), with the screen dimmer than they are (screen median 114 now)
Visible signs of life at the seat: a glass, a record and a coat legible in the foreground, not dark blobs

No CG giveaways: no denoiser smear on the cones and batts, no clipped neon strips on the plinth edges (clip 0.6 to 0.9 % there now), fir boards with real variation (checks, nail holes, darker end grain), carpet with pile and falloff
A believable seated interiors lens: true verticals, 28 to 35 mm, a foreground table edge in front rather than a blank grey slab
A sense of a specific room: the limewashed walls, the tub chairs and the hexagonal tables read as designed objects, not black silhouettes

defects.what: Screen is the brightest large surface (lum_median 113.6), neutral cool grey-violet, pulls the eye away from the altar and reads as a projector
Ceiling and upper walls fall to black (lum_median 4.1, crush 37.8 %): no beams, no concrete, room has no top
Left speaker under-lit (lum_median 27.4) and reads as a dark box; cone and batts show denoiser smear
Right speaker under-lit (lum_median 23.7); white batts at the base smear into blotches; specular streak on the horn's lower lip reads as a CG highlight
Left plinth's glowing edge clips (clip 0.6 %, p95 251) as a thin neon strip, signage-like
Right plinth's glowing edge clips (clip 0.88 %, p95 251)
Record sleeve against the plinth reads as a blank beige card, no artwork, no thickness
Fir boards are uniform, evenly spaced and repeat; no checks, nail holes or variation in width; smooth CG grain
Carpet is a flat brown plane (lum_range 72), no pile, no pool of light from the altar spots on the floor
Orb lamp glows cool blue-white (b 191 > r 167) against a 2700 K room; the frosted face is a featureless disc
Foreground hexagonal table reads as a smooth pink-grey slab; no oak grain, no props legible on it
Right tub chairs crush to near-black silhouettes (lum_median 9.6); velvet nap not readable
Niche's outer fir return and the wall beyond are a dull ramp with no material
Niche header fascia is a plain smooth band; downlight hot spots on it are the only detail

changes.problem: The hero speakers are dimmer than the screen and the niche boards, so the altar does not read at a glance.

evidence.measured: speaker lum_median 23.7 (left 27.4) vs fir boards 77.8 and screen 113.6

change.to: 70 W, cone 24 deg, aimed at the cabinet's mid-height so the light passes through the tinted acrylic onto the white batts

changes.expected: Both cabinets glow from within; speaker regions lum_median 45 to 70, cone and batts legible without lifting the boards above about 95

changes.problem: The screen is the brightest large surface and steals the frame.
changes.expected: The screen sits as a dim image in the dark, below the speakers

changes.problem: The frame shows a niche in a void: the shell (beams, concrete, steel), the limewashed walls and the zone's furniture are cropped out or black, so it reads as a generic demo room, and the lens is a standing 24 mm with a blank slab in front.

evidence.measured: top band lum_median 4.1, crush 37.8 %; foreground table a featureless slab

change.to: seated, about [12.6, 2.4, 1.15], 32 mm, level, at [16.5, 3.05, 1.05], with a fir beam crossing the top of the frame and the middle hexagonal table with the glass and record in the lower left foreground; f/4 focused on the near speaker

changes.expected: One beam and the concrete above the niche enter the frame, the zone reads as a room within a room, a sign of life sits in the foreground

changes.problem: The frame is a touch too dark overall and the shadows are empty rather than deep.

evidence.measured: frame lum_p50 19.0; 67.2 % of pixels below 40; chairs at right lum_median 9.6

changes.expected: Frame median about 26 to 30, the chairs' velvet and the walls hold detail, the altar spots show faint beams

changes.problem: The plinths' glowing edges clip into thin neon strips that read as signage.

change.setting: the light plinth glow under each speaker (emission strength) and the frosted acrylic's roughness
change.to: about half the strength, frosted roughness up so the glow spreads softly over the plinth top rather than along its edge

changes.expected: A soft even glow under each cabinet, no clipped line

changes.problem: The denoiser smears the cones and the white batts into blotches, the biggest single CG tell on the hero.

evidence.measured: batts at the base of the right cabinet read as smudged white patches in a 2x crop

change.to: 1024, adaptive 0.005, denoise on with albedo and normal passes, at full 2400 x 1600 rather than the 0.5 proof

changes.expected: Batt fibres and the cone's surround legible at 1:1

changes.problem: The fir boards and the carpet read as smooth CG surfaces.

evidence.measured: boards uniform, falloff bins 106 to 61 smooth with no board-to-board variation; carpet lum_range 72 flat

change.to: fir with per-board tone variation of about 10 %, checks and nail holes, a little sheen; carpet with a pile bump and a slight sheen so the altar spots leave a pool on the floor in front of the plinths

changes.expected: Boards read as reclaimed fir, a pool of light falls on the floor in front of the altar

changes.problem: No sign of life reads: the sleeve against the plinth is a blank card and the table props are lost.

evidence.measured: sleeve a flat beige rectangle, lum_median 73.9 with no artwork

change.to: a sleeve with real printed artwork and a visible spine, a rocks glass with a finger of whisky and a record out of its sleeve on the foreground table caught by the Orb's light, the coat over the near tub chair's arm

changes.expected: Two or three readable signs of life in the frame

out_of_scope.request: Give the frame one saturated colour from the speaker
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration's tint is fixed on the card; the speakers are smoked, so the frame has no saturated colour by design. Another configuration would carry it.

out_of_scope.request: Show one speaker rather than a matched pair
out_of_scope.why: The altar's pair is fixed by the room's design; the two identical cabinets are correct, not a repeated asset.

out_of_scope.request: Warm the Orb's frosted liner, which reads cool blue-white
out_of_scope.why: The Orb's tint and liner are a fixed EARF product; only its glow level may change. A lower Orb glow and the 2700 K grade will lessen the cast.

out_of_scope.request: Make the niche's flat fascia and the plain plinth blocks more crafted
out_of_scope.why: The niche and the altar are part of the room's design as proposed.
